_comment: THE GOLDEN VENUE CONFIG, as it ran on LITE3-A (robot 1) on 2026-09-07. Copy to /home/user/mappo-lite3-stage/dc/run-profile.json and RESTART the driver: run_control.load_profile is called once at driver startup (robot_driver.py:2181), so an edit without a restart changes nothing and the next run looks identical. Robot 2 is the same file with the BORROWED-FROM-ROBOT1 calibration paths and MAPPO_ROBOT_ID=LITE3-B; its ranging reads ~10cm optimistic because those optics are robot 1's, which is why it stops closer than this --arrive says. || --arrive 0.55, raised from 0.50 on 2026-09-07: at 0.50 both robots reached the goal tripod and caught its legs. This is the number that stops that, and it is the only lever that does -- the overrun is not a control error, telemetry showed robot 2 stopping at distance_m 0.4994 against a 0.5 tolerance and believing it had arrived correctly. || MAPPO_FLIP=0 is OFF and is the shipped value. MAPPO_FLIP_REAR_CLEARANCE_M is DELIBERATELY ABSENT: it is a tape measurement of the floor behind the goal, the action travels ~1.5m backward into the robot's only blind direction, and look_behind's detector finds VOC classes and cannot see a wall, a step or a stage edge. Until it is measured and added here, ticking the dashboard box prints which setting is missing and does not flip. That is the intended behaviour, not a bug.
